balls.text: Starc finishes with a wicket, and what a brilliant final over this has been! After taking pace off the last ball, Starc goes for the searing full delivery. Tails into middle and off, and Arshad, swinging like a rusty gate, does not get anywhere near the ball. Crashes into the stumps, and LSG are held to 161!
slower ball dug into the track on leg stump. Krunal swings a week early and cops a blow on the back thigh for his troubles

excellent yorker just outside off. Tails back in late, and seems to go past Arshad's swing. Krunal is alert enough and sneaks in a bye. Salt wanted to go upstairs, not sure why. Looks like the on-field umpire has brought his colleague into play. The ball has bounced after going past the bat, so everything else is immaterial
oh! Right in the slot just outside off. Arshad swings his blade like an axe but does not make any contact
Arshad begins with a boundary! Banged in short outside off and Arshad has the license to swing for the hills. Gets it nowhere near the middle but the ball flies off the top edge over the keeper!

edged and gone! No Pooran pyrotechnics in the final over! Length delivery hung up a long way outside off. In fact, it was beyond the tramlines. Pooran went after it and because it was so far, he could only feather it through to Salt. Subdued celebrations, but this is a huge wicket, and could possibly alter the score by 10-12 runs, at least!
full and wide outside off. Pooran holds his shape this time and slices it down to deep backward point. Retains strike for the final over
slower ball dug into the track outside off. Pooran tries to smash it into the Bay of Bengal but only swats away a few flies in the process

full and wide outside off. Pooran gives it the lot but only swishes at thin air. Seemed inside the tramlines but Pooran has reviewed nonetheless. The ball is passing clearly inside the tramlines, and the original decision stands!

safe, and it rolls away for four! Pooran well and truly on the charge! Banged into the track on leg stump. Gets up high, perhaps to where Rana wants. Pooran, though, swipes at it so hard that he clears square leg, with the ball then trickling into the ropes, despite Starc's dive!
another wayward delivery outside off that just tests out Phil Salt's skills behind the stumps. More exercise for the umpire

streaky but they all count! Slower ball on a length outside off. Pooran nearly swings himself off his feet, and that amount of effort takes the outside edge over short third man. First four for Pooran today!
bowls this a mile outside off. A wide yorker gone wrong and the umpire has no hesitation in calling this a wide
off-pace on a length well outside off. Pooran does well to reach it but can only chalk it off the toe-end towards short third man

low full toss slanted into leg stump. Krunal closes his bat face too early and the ball bobbles off the leading edge towards long off. Pooran wants the second to retain strike and makes it comfortably enough
full outside off. Pooran drills it out towards deep cover point. The bat face opened upon impact and that rid him of the requisite power
very full on off stump. Pooran, sitting deep in his crease, swings at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards deep mid wicket for a brace
the change of angle makes no difference! Goes short again, this time on middle and off. That is right where Pooran wants it and he slugs it over deep backward square leg!
Pooran power! Another slower bouncer on middle and leg. Pooran sizes it up early, gets on top of it and muscles it over deep mid wicket!
slower bumper on leg stump. Barely gets to Krunal and he hacks it towards deep square leg
short outside off. Pooran wafts at it away from his body and only connects with fresh air. The last four balls were six or nothing
sharp bumper just outside off. Zips off the surface and whizzes past Pooran's flailing blade as he looks to pull. Pooran feels he missed out there
full and angled across the batter well outside off. Pooran swishes at it and misses. That was on-pace too and Pooran was probably not expecting it
right out of the screws! Another off-pace ball but this sits up nicely outside off. Pooran opens up his front hip and whacks it over wide long on!
back of a length just outside off. Krunal advances and chips it on the bounce to deep cover point
cutter on a back of a length outside off. Pooran throws his hands at it and scuffs it towards deep cover point
short outside off again. Pooran hops back and punches it towards deep cover point
short and wide outside off. Krunal goes back and cuts it towards deep cover point
quicker and flatter on a length on leg stump. Pooran is rushed into the stroke and works it into the mid wicket region
back of a length outside off. Comes off more sluggishly than Krunal expects and he jabs it to deep cover point
full on leg stump. Krunal gets onto the front foot and blocks
shortish outside off. Pooran reaches out for it and slaps it towards deep cover point
full on middle and off. Pooran gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long off
length on middle and leg. Krunal comes forward and pokes it into the on side for a single

goes straight up, and Badoni bites the dust! Slowed up just a shade on a length outside off. Seems to drift away late too. Badoni tries the expansive sweep but cannot get to the pitch of the ball. Skews it off the top edge and the ball swirls towards deep backward square leg. Raghuvanshi circles under it, tracks it all the way and holds on. LSG keep losing wickets!
back of a length on off. Pooran stays back and punches it towards long off
fired in fuller on leg stump. Badoni comes forward and flicks it towards deep mid wicket

another lbw appeal, not given by umpire Akshay Totre! Length ball on off, that comes in with the angle. Badoni has a hack across the line and misses it completely. Gets struck on the back leg, and this looks awfully close. KKR think so too, and take it upstairs. If Badoni has not hit this, he could be in trouble. There is a slight spike when the ball is next to the bat, and Badoni survives. Excellent decision, given that scraped the toe-end!
length just outside off. Pooran pushes it towards extra cover and sets off for the single, only for Badoni to send him back
another away-going delivery on a length outside off. Pooran wafts at it and only connects with fresh air
length on middle and leg. Pooran reads it off the pitch and plays it towards extra cover
hung up outside off but this, again, is too wide. Pooran swishes and misses, and then sees the umpire call it a wide
short and wide outside off. Badoni stays back and cuts it towards deep point
very full on middle and leg. Pooran clears his front leg and powers it down the ground to long off
length delivery darted across the batter way outside off. Some more exercise for the umpire
That. Is. Massive. Proper buffet ball. Knee-high full toss on leg stump, and Pooran rubs his eyes once before smoking that deep into the crowd over mid wicket!
back of a length on leg stump. Pooran goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
slow on a back of a length on the stumps. Sticks in the surface too as Pooran defends
floated up full outside off. Badoni lunges forward and turns it towards deep mid wicket
short and wide outside off. Pooran hops back and cuts it towards deep cover point
slowed up on a length outside off. Pooran tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it into the off side
length on off. Badoni stretches forward and pushes it towards long on

just short! Googly given a bit of air on a full length outside off. Pooran has a huge swing at it and slices it on the bounce to short third man. On another day, that would have carried comfortably to Narine
length on leg stump. Pooran lets the ball arrive before meeting it right under his eyes

smart work by Salt, and Stoinis has to walk back! Tossed up a touch on a length outside off. Grips in the surface and rips back in. Stoinis does not account for that much turn and jams it off the inside edge into his pads. The ball pops up and Salt keeps his eyes on it all the way. Reacts quick enough and snaffles it sharply to his right, one-handed. KKR keep chipping away, and LSG, in trying to increase the tempo, have lost two in quick succession!
quicker and flatter. Low full toss on off and Badoni knocks it to long on
watch out in the crowd! Incoming delivery that lands right in the slot on off. Badoni gets down on one knee, picks it up and dumps it over cow corner!
very full just outside off. Badoni digs it out towards extra cover. A bit of hesitation between the batters and they decide against taking the single
the full ball comes now but it is on the pads, allowing Stoinis to work it towards deep mid wicket. Stoinis has to hurry for the second, and makes it in the end
thumped! Half-tracker on off stump that is just begging to be hit. Stoinis rises with the bounce and hammers it between deep mid wicket and deep square leg!
Russell tests out the middle of the track for the fourth ball running. Seems to balloon over Stoinis' head but not called a wide
Stoinis starts off with a boundary! Russell goes short again but Stoinis is waiting for this. Stands up tall and belts it past deep mid wicket!

holes out to deep mid wicket! Russell gets Rahul! Another shortish ball, although this is on the stumps. Rahul, trying to up the ante, opens up his stance and swipes at it. Gets a decent piece of it but the only problem is that he hits it straight down Ramandeep's throat. Much easier catch, compared to earlier, and LSG lose their skipper!
KLaasy! Banged in short outside off and Rahul climbs into it. Jumps up onto his toes and scythes it over the deep point fence!

a polite lbw enquiry but nothing more than that! Given a bit of air on a length just outside off. Spins back into Badoni and hits the front pad as he plays down the wrong line. Okay, looks like there was bat involved too. Off the inside edge into the front pad
back of a length outside off. Rahul hangs back in his crease and jabs it past backward point
full on middle and off. Badoni looks for the flick and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
length just outside off. Rahul presses half forward and knocks it down to long on
back of a length on the stumps. Badoni tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg

boundary straight after the time-out! A bit of a freebie really. On a length well down leg. Badoni glances it past short fine leg. Russell comes around from deep backward square leg but his footie skills are not quite up to scratch
back of a length just outside off. Badoni eases it out to deep mid wicket. And that brings us to the first time-out of the day
full on middle and leg. Rahul gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg

massive appeal, not given! Fired in very full on off and Rahul, looking for the sweep, is completely beaten by how full it is. Narine was vociferous in his appeal, but it might have just hit Rahul outside off. Replays confirm the impact was probably a touch outside the line
fullish on off. Badoni comes half forward and pokes it towards deep square leg
short on off stump. Rahul waits and punches it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Rahul stays back and chops it towards backward point
slower ball on a full length on off. Rahul pushes it down to long on and settles for a single
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Rahul plays it very late and dabs it past backward point for a couple of runs
another cutter, on a length on middle and off. Badoni turns it towards deep square leg
full and speared into middle and off. Rahul, perhaps expecting the short ball, is caught on the crease and prods it towards mid off
off-pace on a full length on middle and leg. Badoni works it towards deep square leg
banged into the track outside off. Badoni has a swipe at it but only grabs a handful of fresh air. Called one bouncer for the over
angled well down leg. Badoni gets bat to it but cannot get it past Chakravarthy at short fine leg
length just outside off. Rahul sits deep in his crease and eases it out to long on
on a length just outside off. Nips back in and cramps Rahul for room. Kept out via a combination of inside edge and thigh pad
shortish outside off. Badoni goes back and punches it to long off
back of a length outside off. Rahul camps on the back foot and taps it towards backward point
floated up full outside off. Badoni stretches forward and knocks it to long on
picks the gap! Shortish outside off again. Rahul rides the bounce and opens the bat face very late to steer it between backward point and short third!
off-cutter on a back of a length outside off. Cuts back into Badoni, and he drops it behind point for a single
shortish outside off. Badoni takes a step down the track before dabbing it towards backward point
back of a length on off. Badoni gets behind the line of the ball and plays it towards the bowler

that is some way to get off the mark! Over-pitched outside off and Badoni unfurls a classical cover drive. Gets to the pitch, gets his hands through the ball and finds the gap between cover point and extra cover!
oh! Hard length just outside off. Nips back in and causes Rahul some trouble. He stabs at it and jams it off the inside edge into his back thigh. Rolls past the stumps for a single
length in the channel again. Badoni lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
dug in short outside off. Badoni gets up on his toes and fends it into the off side

taken superbly at backward point by Ramandeep Singh! Length in the channel just outside off. Nips away a smidgen with the angle too. Hooda tries to drive on the up but cannot keep it down. Skews off the outer half of the bat and arrows towards backward point, where Ramandeep flies to his right and snares it. He was almost parallel to the ground when he took that, and KKR will be chuffed with that wicket!
length just outside off. Rahul waits for it and pushes it towards deep cover point. Might have been a cutter
shot! Back of a length outside off, and the width allows Rahul to climb into it. Stands up tall and crashes it over cover for four!
shortish on leg stump. Rahul hops up onto his toes and stabs it towards mid wicket
length outside off. A bit of hold in the surface and Hooda plonks it back to the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Hooda presses half forward and defends
nicely done! Slower bumper on off. Gets up close to his grille but Hooda watches it all the way, taking his bottom hand off the stroke to help it over the keeper!
back of a length on leg stump. Rahul uses the angle and tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
length outside off. Rahul gets a half stride forward and prods it into the off side. That seemed to hit Rahul high on the bat
back of a length delivery angled into off stump. Hooda waits in his crease and works it into the mid wicket region
pulled away with disdain! Banged in short on leg stump, and it sits up for Rahul. He rocks back, swivels and hammers it behind square!
full just outside off. Hooda comes onto the front foot and pokes it back past the bowler for one
back of a length just outside off. Rahul dabs it towards backward point and calls Hooda through for the single
fires this down leg. Rahul does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
brutish short ball that rears up just outside off. Hooda has to hop around his crease but does well to drop it behind point. Picks up a single for his toil
another play and miss! Hard length outside off, slanting away from the batter. Hooda fishes at it away from his body and is lucky to not nick it
play and miss! Back of a length in the channel. Threatens to shape in before pitching and going on with the angle. Hooda goes feeling for it and is beaten all ends up
sharp, short delivery on leg stump that climbs onto Hooda. He gets into an awkward tangle but manages to fend it into the ground on the leg side. Rahul is alert enough to sneak in a single

taken this time! de Kock perishes early! Fullish and slanted across the batter outside off. de Kock goes after it again, but does so with minimal footwork. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball floats to Narine at short third, who accepts the offering gleefully. Arora did not begin this over well, but he has certainly come back strong since!
length on leg stump. Shapes away from de Kock and opens up him. He prods at it and gets an outside edge that dribbles towards short third
full and angling into off stump. Rahul tips it to mid off and hares across to the other end
up and over! Full enough outside off and Rahul makes the most of it. Shows some early intent, goes through the line and lifts it over extra cover!
excellent yorker, well outside off but inside the tramlines. Rahul cannot lay bat on it and Arora gets away with the free hit
oh dear, what is happening here?! It is a good delivery. On a hard length on off. Straightens and squares up Rahul as he defends. But...Arora has overstepped...

back of a length delivery way outside off. Called a wide. Again, not a lot of carry. Okay, hang on. KKR have reviewed this. The ball is on the line. The third umpire concludes that Rahul is standing in a normal batting position too. And because the ball is exactly on top of the line, the original decision stands! KKR lose a review, very early in the piece!

hard length just outside off. de Kock gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point. That fielder and the one at slip go after the same ball. Backward point, in trying to dive and stop it, misfields and ends up conceding the second
peach! Length in the channel. Curves away late, and the initial line forces de Kock to poke at it. Breezes past the outside edge. Barely carried through to Salt, though
fuller on off. de Kock comes onto the front foot and pushes it back towards the bowler
length on middle and off. de Kock presses half forward and taps it down the ground to mid off
four more, although this is much streakier! Length outside off and this leaves the batter too. de Kock chases after it and gets a thick outside edge that flies past slip and beats third man!
off the mark beautifully! Full and swinging away from the batter on off. de Kock steps into the drive and times it exquisitely past the bowler!

Eden Gardens ecstasy for the Kolkata Knight Riders! A half-tracker down leg and that perhaps sums up LSG's day. Salt hops onto the back foot and pummels it behind square to seal the deal. Back to back home wins for KKR, and back to back defeats now for LSG - both of them have come when defending 160-plus scores too!
darted in full on middle and off. Salt plays it back to the bowler
slanted into leg stump. Shreyas does not get bat on it and the ball trickles off the thigh pad towards short fine leg
full on middle and leg. Salt presses forward and eases it down to long off
very full on off. Salt comes forward and drills it down the ground to long off
shortish outside off. Shreyas stays on top of the bounce and cuts it towards deep point
cutter again, banged into the track well outside off. Shreyas drags it towards mid wicket
fullish on middle and leg. Salt clears his front leg and tugs it towards deep square leg
oh my days, that is huuuuuggeee! Slower ball that sits up to be hit outside off. Salt reads the slower one like the morning daily and clatters it over deep mid wicket. 98m six!
Salt wants to finish this nice and early! Half-tracker on middle and off. Salt swings at it with all his might and gets it through backward square leg for four!
slower bumper outside off. Salt rolls his wrists over it and eases it towards deep square leg
this is a high-quality stroke! Change of pace again, this time on a back of a length outside off. Salt picks it, holds his shot and creams it off the back foot over extra cover!
banged in short outside off. Shreyas gets on top of the bounce and swats it towards deep square leg
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Salt waits for it and hacks it towards extra cover
another gift! Knee-high full toss down leg, and this is ordinary bowling. Salt uses the pace and helps it past short fine leg!
30 needed now! Off-pace again but this is in the slot outside off. Salt frees his arms and carves it over extra cover!
slower ball bowled full and quite wide outside off. Salt has a fresh-air shot but to his delight, sees the umpire stretch out his arms
Joseph's debut IPL spell ends with a boundary! Short and wide outside off. Shreyas capitalises on the width and while he does not middle it, the ball races away off the bat past third man!
slot ball, angling into middle and leg. Shreyas looks to whip it away but can only inside-edge it onto his front pad

slower ball that ends up as a low full toss on leg stump. Salt shuffles across, gets down low and helps it on the bounce to long leg. Uh-oh, Joseph has overstepped again. That will not please Morne Morkel!
back of a length just outside off. Shreyas opens his bat face and runs it down to third man
length outside off. Seems to just stick in the surface and that meddles with Shreyas' timing. Scuffed back to the bowler
wayward short delivery, well down leg. Rahul flings out his left mitt and collects to prevent five wides
picks the gap! Half-tracker on middle and leg, and this barely gets up to Shreyas' ribs. He can swivel easily and batters it between fine leg and deep square leg!
low full toss on middle and leg. Shreyas presses forward and flicks it enough to long on's right to saunter back for two
finds the fence! Mohsin sticks to the cutters on a shortish length. Salt picks this early enough, moves inside the line and swings it away past long leg!
short on leg stump. Shreyas hops up onto his toes and tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg

another mix-up, and Salt survives! Shortish outside off. Shreyas dabs it towards backward point. He is not really interested in the single but Salt has hared half-way down, only to be sent back. No one to collect the throw at the bowler's end and the throw was not near the stumps anyway. Salt was miffed, though, and was probably asking his skipper to stop ball-watching
slower ball dug into the track on leg stump. Salt swivels nicely and helps it towards deep backward square leg
off-pace on a back of a length on off. Shreyas waits for it and guides it past backward point. A bit of miscommunication but no damage done because it was enough to the fielder's left
another bouncer, but this sails harmlessly over Shreyas' head. Called a wide for height

dug into the track on leg stump. Shreyas steps across his stumps and tries to swipe it away. Seems to miss it but LSG, initially at least, are very interested in the caught-behind. Once the umpire says no, though, they do not review
googly on a length outside off. Salt wafts at it away from his body and misses. Not sure Salt is picking Bishnoi
fired in fuller and flatter on off. Salt continues swinging and jams it off the inside edge into his pads. That was bowled at 102.5kph
shorter and angling into the pads. Salt has a massive mow across the line and gets an inside edge that loops up off the back leg. Into safety, though
hung up full outside off. Shreyas drives at it but ends up scuffing it into the point region
Bishnoi pushes this down leg again, and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise
back of a length on off. Salt stays leg side and dabs it towards backward point
full outside off. Shreyas plants his front foot and hacks it to long on
slanted in on a length on leg stump. Salt misses his flick and the ball deflects off the pads towards backward point
full and wide outside off again. Salt tries to crash it through cover but only swishes at thin air. Lets out a groan of frustration soon after
fifty for Salt - his second this season! Half-volley wide outside off, and that is just asking for trouble. Salt throws the plumbing at it and scythes it past backward point!
more fortune favouring Salt! Hard length, targeting the stumps. Salt has a fence at it without any footwork, and squirts it off the inside edge, past short fine leg for four!

back of a length delivery that finishes on leg stump. Shreyas, having moved across, plays all over it and gets pinged on the front thigh. Arshad and Rahul appealed but it is very likely that pitched outside leg. Replays confirm it pitched well outside leg
that has flown off the bat! Short and wide outside off. Shreyas lets the ball come to him before knifing it past backward point. Third man had no chance either!
full outside off. Shreyas gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long off
shorter on middle and off. Salt opens up his stance and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket
full outside off. Salt tries to go inside out but loses his shape, shanking it off the inside half of the bat towards the bowler
googly on a back of a length outside off. Shreyas goes back and punches it to long on
sprays this down leg again. Shreyas does not get bat on it and the umpire calls it a wide
back of a length delivery down leg again. Shreyas tickles it towards short fine leg
a shocking delivery to start off the spell! Half-tracker outside leg and Shreyas pinches himself first just to make sure this is real. Helps it on its way over short fine leg and picks up four!
banged into the track on off stump. Shreyas gets inside the line, rolls his wrists and pulls it to deep square leg
back of a length outside off. Shreyas tries the cute, little dab but makes no contact whatsoever

Shreyas breaks free! Shortish outside off. Shreyas moves across his stumps early and bashes it back past the bowler. A spectacular effort by Hooda, running to his left from long on, but he cannot rein it in!
hard length on off. Shreyas is late on the stroke and jams it off the inside edge into his thigh pad
short and wide outside off. Salt throws his hands at it and cuts it towards deep cover point
edged and four! Back of a length on leg stump. Nips back into Salt and zips off the surface too. Salt is beaten for pace but luckily for him, the inside edge hurtles away past short fine leg!
sprayed a mile down leg, and Rahul does well to get something behind it. Just the two extras for KKR
yorker speared into leg stump. Salt does not get bat on it and the ball trickles off the pads towards fine leg. Thakur dives to his left and saves two

parried over the bar! Shortish on middle and leg. Salt stands tall and whips it away towards deep square leg. Arshad settles himself on the fence but palms it over the bar. Not a difficult chance in front of his face, and LSG will be gutted about that!
safe! Shreyas is not looking comfortable when the ball is at his body. This gets up close to his grille and he top-edges it on the bounce to fine leg

huge appeal, and given! Shreyas reviews it straightaway! Hard length again, slanting into leg stump and cramping Shreyas for room. He tries to help it fine and seems to miss it, with the ball brushing the thigh pad on its way to the keeper. The quickness of the review suggests exactly that, and the replays confirm it too. Clear spike off the thigh pad, and Shreyas survives!
hard length on leg stump. Skids onto Salt and he, after hopping onto his toes, tugs it towards deep square leg
shortish just outside off. Salt has a swipe across the line but is beaten for pace, and by the inward movement. Not far away from the stumps either
back of a length just outside off. Shreyas stays back and drops it into the off side with soft hands
just short! Hard length just outside off. Shreyas tries to stand tall and go over mid off. The ball sticks a little, though, and Shreyas clinks it on the bounce to mid off
another play and miss! KKR have made 58 so far but there have been quite a few of these too. On a back of a length outside off. A bit of nibble away and it breezes past Shreyas' prod
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Salt digs it out into the mid on region and picks up a single
back to back boundaries for Salt again! This is also short, perhaps a little closer to off stump. Salt generates room by jumping up onto his toes and carves it over cover point!
Salt continues on his merry way! Slow and short outside off. Salt picks the change of pace, holds his stroke long enough and glides it past backward point!
back of a length on off. Shreyas gets behind the line and presents the full face of the bata
back of a length just outside off. Shreyas hangs back and prods it into the off side
Shreyas gets his first boundary! Drifts onto the pads and pays the price. Plenty of pace on this too and Shreyas can just glance it fine for four!
back of a length outside off. Salt gets up on his toes and jabs it towards deep cover point
ripper! Back of a length delivery in the channel that curves away late. Salt nibbles at it and is squared up completely. Play and a miss!
hard length on middle and leg. Seems to just hold in the surface and hits Salt high on the bat as he defends. Popped up into the air but it was well to Joseph's right
this is slower but on a similar length on off. Shreyas, having walked across his stumps, fends it into the off side. Looks like it was the off-cutter
jaffa! Length on middle and leg. Threatens to shape in but nips away off the surface. Shreyas is opened up like a deck chair and beaten comprehensively
back of a length outside off again. Shreyas waits for it and defends
dug in short on leg stump. Gets a little big on Salt and he splices his pull towards deep square leg
back of a length just outside off. Shreyas plays with the angle and runs it down to third man

Mohsin has two, and LSG are fighting back! Back of a length delivery slanted across the batter outside off. Goes on with the angle and forces Raghuvanshi to play at it. He does so without much conviction and nicks it through to Rahul. The easiest of catches for the LSG skipper, and Mohsin is pumped!
safe! On a length outside off. Holds in the surface and spins away. Raghuvanshi pokes at it and almost pops it to Bishnoi at backward point. Enough to his right to survive
angled in on a length on leg stump. Raghuvanshi plays all over it and gets pinged on the front pad. Was probably going down leg, though
fuller on middle and off. Salt comes forward and drives it down to long off
crrunnnchhheeededdd! Marginally short outside off, and that is right up Salt's alley. Stands tall and crunches it to mid off's left!
four more! In the slot again, this time on the pads. Salt bends his back knee and sweeps it well over backward square leg. One bounce and into the fence!
Salt welcomes Krunal with a boundary! Darted into the slot outside off. Salt plants his front foot and thumps it over the bowler's head!
goes all the way! Length ball on the pads and it gets the treatment it deserves. Raghuvanshi snaps his wrists into the stroke and lifts it over the long leg fence!
shortish outside off. Raghuvanshi stands up on his toes and punches it crisply towards backward point, where Bishnoi sprawls to his right and prevents a certain boundary
back of a length in the channel. Decks away with the angle and that draws Raghuvanshi into a poke away from his body. Beaten all ends up

Narine will not dominate the powerplay tonight! Mohsin sticks to that hard length just outside off, and takes the pace off this time. Narine was always going to go after it, but the lack of pace means that he miscues it. Gets plenty of height, but not enough distance. Stoinis, stood at cover point and on the edge of the ring, does the rest!
hard length on middle and leg. Hurries onto Narine quicker than he anticipates and he cloths it to mid on
back of a length just outside off. Kisses the surface and zips through, sneaking past the outside edge of Narine's dab
Joseph gets pumped down the ground! 146.4kph but this is right into the slot outside off. Salt swings through the line and bangs it over mid off. And the first over finally comes to an end!
full and speared down leg. Salt steps across to the off side and then watches it go through to Rahul. And it is another No ball. The wheels are coming off already for Shamar Joseph!

oh dear, this is going from bad to worse! Sprays this well down leg. Salt swings and misses. Rahul cannot get close to it either. Five extras added to KKR's total, and they still have a free hit to tuck into!
full and wide, possibly a slower ball that has gone wrong. Beyond the tramlines too and the free hit continues

dropped, oh dear! 150.7kph delivery, bowled on a hard length and slanting into leg stump. Salt gets inside the line and helps it towards short fine leg. Thakur dives to his right but puts it down. That is not all because...Joseph has overstepped!
beauty! 146.5kph heat-seeking missile that pitches just outside off and jags back sharply. Cuts Narine in half and Rahul can only get fingertips to it. A bye to KKR

hard length just outside off. Narine continues swinging because, well, that is what he does. Skews this off the outside edge and it loops over short third. Hooda chases after it, puts in the dive and saves two
Narine is up and running! Too much width and this is short enough too. Narine stands up tall and cracks it through cover point for four!
hard length, angling into leg stump. Salt is rushed on the pull and cannot lay bat on it. Loops up off the thigh pad towards short fine leg. That was bowled at 140.7kph
back of a length on off. Shapes away a little and squares up Salt as he prods it off the back foot towards backward point
